notes.title: Optimizations and Performance!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35041579/7db206afe56ad511cbece5b188dcadd3791591db.jpg[/img]
Hi everyone!

This weekend I created an algorithm able to increase performance for big maps at least 20%!!!

Many of our players are incredible! You are creating REALLY BIG and powerful mining bases! Congratulations! 

Besides the optimization, what is new in this version:

- map creation is faster.
- the game memory usage and performance increased between 20% to 50%
- when the game loses focus it stops scrolling. (even if you don't pause the game).
- MacOs bug with Game Center.
- Bug when posting Leaderboard it gets an error from Steam every 30 seconds. Now it doesn't happen anymore.

Now we are going to work in some bugs and corner belts! We hope that this version will solve many optimization issues for now! 

Thank you for playing!

notes.title: Update May-31-2019 - First Week
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35041579/b9c9bf65c59e8ca56529bf807e73012fde0cec8f.jpg[/img]
First, we want to thanks to all players playing Factory Coin Mining!

You are great! So many feedbacks and reviews! 

And if you enjoyed the game, please, give us a recommendation [url=https://store.steampowered.com/recommended/recommendgame/1069910]HERE[/url]

[b]This is what you can find in this update:[/b]
- Satellite selling value increased from 10700 to 20700.
- "+1 item" messages now happens on the item, not in the middle of the screen.
- Added 32 achievements.
- High scores now update in real time, not only when you get Factory Coin.
- Solved a UI bug: if you are moving the scenario and roll over a UI, the movement stops.
- Splitters much faster.
- Better animation of inserters when picking up and releasing an item.
- Added a link to the youtube video Tutorial a did a few days ago.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=poQ98jGZmEU

[b]What we are working on right now:[/b]
- As many of you are asking, we are implementing the corner/curved belts.
- Increase performance for really large scenarios.
- "Fog of War" and a Radar item.

That is it for this week! Much more to come in the future! 
Thank again for your engagement! We are working really hard to make the game better and better for you!

notes.title: Update May-27-2019 - New Features!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35041579/17b0f0bdde6ac106c2c0371e870b84e7215721a4.jpg[/img]
Hello all! Thank you for playing this weekend!!! We are very happy with all your reviews and comments!

[b]IF YOU ARE ENJOYING THIS GAME, PLEASE[/b]: give us a positive review to recommend the game to others! 
Otherwise, we will not appear well in the search and fewer people are going to play Factory Coin Mining! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/recommended/recommendgame/1069910]REVIEW US HERE![/url]

We are working to get all your requests in order! What we changed in this update:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35041579/f4f2cc57741101775f4f3cbbcccbc63072efbf7a.jpg[/img]
FEATURES:
[b]+ LEADERBOARD[/b] Now is perfectly working. Click on the trophy on you map frame to activate/deactivate leaderboards.
[b]+ ACHIEVEMENTS:[/b] We are starting to add the Achievements! Until the end of this week, we expect more than +50 achievements! 

BUG FIXES:
- chest bug fix when you collect a raw resource with a chest under the pipe.
- Some items after load stop moving on belts. Now it is expected to move.
- Research Building appearing in some factories are now fixed. 
- Save/Load problem when installing Research Buildings. 

The Research Buildings are removed from Factory Build Tree for now. Soon it will be available and working! 

IMPROVEMENTS
- Splitters are working faster. It makes the experience better and you don't need to use inserters to do the job! But it is still your call!
- W A S D speed control in Options -> Game Play Menu.

Thank you again for all your reviews and comments!

notes.title: Release May 24, 2019!!!
notes.notes:

We are very excited to release the first version of our game still [b]this month[/b]!

We are still working really hard to bring as many features as we can in the first version! So we can focus all the next efforts in new thing asked for you!

Of course, the game is already HUGE. Be ready for many gameplay hours and a lot of fun!
